note: What a server sends its player's champion to have the player draw paths with the mouse. The header names the champion. While on, each right click on the world also sends DrawPath. A client sets how often a held right click repeats a move to the interval, at least 0.1 seconds, whether on or off.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: A client does not use it.

fields.name: mode
fields.note: Zero to turn drawing off, any other value to turn it on.

fields.name: interval
fields.note: Seconds between repeats of a held right click.
